dedupeText: southern barbecue surrealism maximalist southern gothic neon signage food photography urban surrealism bar interior central figure framed by a diagonal human leg and a foreground pile of fried chicken glowing yellow neon text in the upper right balancing a graphic badge in the lower left warm amber bar background contrasting with cool blue clothing and white graphic elements repetitive beer bottle motifs creating a circular frame around the lower half combine subject with surreal food element in a maximalist bar setting using neon signage and graphic badges for a high energy urban aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist, high-contrast scene blending gritty bar interiors with surreal, humorous food-centric imagery and glowing neon typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, saturated composition featuring a central figure interacting with food and surreal elements in a dimly lit bar, framed by glowing neon tubes and graphic badges.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by a diagonal human leg and a foreground pile of fried chicken
Glowing yellow neon text in the upper right balancing a graphic badge in the lower left
Warm, amber bar background contrasting with cool blue clothing and white graphic elements
Repetitive beer bottle motifs creating a circular frame around the lower half
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated color palette with heavy amber and gold tones
Presence of glowing neon tube lighting effects
Maximalist density with no significant empty space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male figure at medium-close scale, partially obscured by a large diagonal foreground element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large pile of textured fried chicken in the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, follows the diagonal leg to the neon sign, then drops to the graphic badge and across the food.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Virtually non-existent; every corner is filled with bottles, signs, or textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Amber and warm browns from the bar and food.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and blacks in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and red from neon signs and graphic badges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with deep, crushed blacks and glowing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pastel or muted earth tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded sans-serif and heavy block lettering.
letterConstructionRules: Neon text must appear as continuous glowing glass tubes with internal light sources.
Badge text uses heavy, condensed sans-serif with high-contrast outlines.
Label text follows a circular or arched path around central icons.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' in neon has rounded terminals to mimic bent glass.
The 'N' in the badge is stylized as a small superscript character.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast glowing, organic neon tubes with rigid, high-contrast block lettering in graphic badges.

preserve: High-contrast black and white advisory box

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the specific glow and bend of bar signage.
For the heavy, authoritative block text in the badges.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a crowded bar scene with a central figure, a large pile of fried chicken in the foreground, and various beer bottles. Ensure warm, amber lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add glowing yellow neon tube lettering in the upper right and a multi-layered graphic badge with a cartoon mascot in the lower left.

verificationChecks: Does the neon have a realistic outer glow?
Is the foreground food texture sharp and high-contrast?
Are the graphic badges clearly legible against the busy background?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the foreground food pile

mustAchieve: Realistic neon lighting interaction with the environment

postGenerationChecks: Check for neon light reflections on the subject's skin.
Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' style box is perfectly rectangular.
Verify that the foreground leg does not look anatomically detached.
Confirm the color palette remains dominated by warm ambers.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Surreal Food Element] in a [Maximalist Bar Setting] using [Neon Signage] and [Graphic Badges] for a high-energy urban aesthetic.
